data.title: 美杜莎 Rider · 厨房里的围裙反差
data.description: 卫宫家厨房，她系着围裙切菜，刀工意外地利落；为樱准备的便当摆得整整齐齐，摘了眼镜揉眼睛的一瞬间露出毫无防备的素颜。

data.promptProse: At the Emiya kitchen counter, Medusa arranges neatly cut vegetables beside an open lunch box, purple apron over a cream blouse and dark trousers. Her long hair is secured away from the chopping area. She pauses to set her glasses on the counter and rub her nose bridge. In the medium view, morning light reveals the orderly pieces and unguarded expression, casting soft shadows from the lunch-box partitions onto the counter.
